interventions.description: Baseline gaps -> explicit interface/manifests/replay -> evidence-based reassessment.
Seven-property evidence, source-version conflict, portable assessment, complete checklist side product.
Raw BIDS revision and attribution preserved; derivatives separated; DataLad transformation; no imaging pipeline.
Boundary, component identities, code/environment interface, executable local research object.
Pre-analysis protocol, complete endpoints, independent checks, disposable replay, explicit scientific limits.

limitations: Temporal association only: run position was not randomized and task composition may differ.
Observed valid responses are the estimand; differential missingness can select the sample.
The 0.2–3.0 s band is a declared sensitivity choice, not a documented response deadline.
Current BIDS validation, remote retrieval, full Pixi environment rebuild, alternate-platform execution and independent investigator reproduction were not attempted.
Local fresh-directory replay uses a venv without pip and the existing base Python interpreter.
Analysis-module licensing and a durable distribution route have not been established.
Native capture and outer duct capture are runner-owned; their contents were not inspected and no per-computation duct logs are claimed.
Native DataLad rerun detection requires its fixed commit-subject prefix; the final Conventional Commit subject retains the run block but uses the verified explicit replay command.
Paper licensing additions and T.4 versus checklist T.5 are source-qualified; no silent remapping.
